The Cinema Snob relives another great year in cinema history!

It’s the year Top Gun gave us the need for speed, Crocodile Dundee taught us what a knife is, and Short Circuit proved Johnny Five is alive.

From hits to cult classics and cinematic disasters, let’s go through the whole year of 1986 IN FILM!
